title: Offbeat Sri Lanka: Dambulla, Sigiriya and Nuwara Eliya
alt: The golden Buddha and cave temples of Dambulla
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Dambulla
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class hotel among the paddy fields outside Dambulla

activities.name: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
activities.description: A stop on the way up from the airport to watch the resident herd bathe in the Maha Oya river and feed at the sanctuary.

activities.name: Excursion to Sigiriya rock fortress
activities.description: A full day out to the fifth century rock citadel: the water gardens, the mirror wall, the frescoes and the summit palace ruins.

program.name: Dambulla
program.description: Two nights in the Cultural Triangle with the elephants on the way in and a full day at the rock fortress of Sigiriya.

stops.name: Nuwara Eliya
stops.hotel: Tea Mount Forest Hotel, Nuwara Eliya
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Standard class hotel set among the tea gardens

activities.name: Half day Kandy sightseeing
activities.description: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, the giant Bahiravokanda Buddha above the town and the Royal Botanical Gardens at Peradeniya.

activities.name: Full day Nuwara Eliya sightseeing
activities.description: Ramboda Falls, a working tea estate and factory, Gregory Lake, Victoria Park, Hakgala gardens and the Seetha Amman temple.

program.name: Nuwara Eliya
program.description: Two nights in the tea country with Kandy on the way up and a full day of waterfalls, gardens and the lake.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Historic harbourside hotel in the Colombo Fort district

activities.name: Private full day Colombo sightseeing
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the colonial Fort district, the Lotus Tower and Pettah market, with entrance tickets payable locally.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A final night in the Fort district with a private full day of the capital.

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Kandy, the hills and then the coast. Sri Lanka works best when you let the island cool you down before it warms you up again.
expert.tip: Carry a light sweater for Nuwara Eliya. It sits at nearly 1,900 metres and evenings are surprisingly chilly even in April.

summary: Six days off the usual loop: two nights at Dambulla with a full day at Sigiriya, two in the tea country at Nuwara Eliya with Kandy on the way, and a last night in Colombo.
included: Included: 5 nights in deluxe and standard class hotels with breakfast and dinner daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary visit; a full day excursion to Sigiriya; half day Kandy sightseeing; full day Nuwara Eliya sightseeing; a private full day Colombo sightseeing tour (entrance tickets payable locally).
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches unless stated; entrance tickets where marked as payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
